Implementation complete for _default_procedure_optimize_batch function in execute.py (inserted after _default_procedure_optimize at line 4377).

Key implementation details:
- Accepts scorecard (required) and scores array (required), plus all standard optimizer params
- Shared parameters distributed to all optimizer runs
- Loops through scores array calling _default_procedure_optimize() for each
- Error handling: failed scores collected in 'failed' array, successful in 'dispatched' array
- Returns structured dict with scorecard, total_scores, dispatched list, failed list

Status: Code complete, ready for testing
